key_insight: The paper provides a validated, reproducible LBM dataset and pipeline for benchmarking neural operators on 3D turbulent obstructed channel flows.
engineering_relevance: It gives CFD researchers a standardized way to train and compare surrogate models for forecasting, super-resolution, and error correction in realistic turbulent geometries.
method: Generate 3D channel-flow cases with obstructed geometries at Re = 1,000–10,000.
Simulate with a cumulant-collision lattice Boltzmann solver and verify against experimental benchmarks.
Use grid-convergence studies at 1024×512×512 to validate the dataset and support fair surrogate evaluation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports validation against experimental Strouhal number, drag coefficients, and turbulent fluctuation data, plus comprehensive grid-convergence testing.
watch_item: The main challenge is ensuring that neural surrogates preserve turbulent energy-cascade physics and remain comparable across tasks and resolutions.
paper_title: A Validated LBM Dataset and Pipeline for Surrogate Modeling of Turbulent 3D Obstructed Channel Flows
